list_area.title: Planet List Panel
list_area.about: The dense glass panel behind the header and the table of planets.

side_panel.title: Side Panel
side_panel.about: The glass panel at the right holding the sort and filter buttons, the send buttons and RETURN.

header.title: List Header
header.about: The column headings of the planet table; the column widths of the rows follow it.

rows.title: Planet Rows
rows.about: The visible rows of the planet table; each row is a hover and click area.

scroll.title: Scroll Bar
scroll.about: The scroll bar beside the planet table.

galaxy_inset.title: Galaxy Inset
galaxy_inset.about: The small black galaxy map; scanned star is marked and a click on a star picks it.

status_line.title: Status Line
status_line.about: A one-line plate showing the status text for the scanned planet.

sort_heading.title: Sort Heading
sort_heading.about: The heading text above the four sort buttons.

sort_climate.title: Sort by Climate
sort_climate.about: Button labelled Climate that sorts the planet list by climate, best first.

sort_minerals.title: Sort by Minerals
sort_minerals.about: Button labelled Minerals that sorts the planet list by minerals, richest first.

sort_size.title: Sort by Size
sort_size.about: Button labelled Size that sorts the planet list by maximum population, highest first.

restrict_heading.title: Restrict Heading
restrict_heading.about: The heading text above the filter buttons.

restrict_enemy.title: No Enemy Presence Filter
restrict_enemy.about: Toggle labelled No Enemy Presence that filters planets with enemy presence out of the list.

restrict_gravity.title: Normal Gravity Filter
restrict_gravity.about: Toggle labelled Normal Gravity that drops planets whose gravity gives your race a productivity penalty.

restrict_hostile.title: Non-Hostile Filter
restrict_hostile.about: Toggle labelled Non-Hostile Environment that drops planets where a farmer would grow no food.

restrict_minerals.title: Mineral Abundance Filter
restrict_minerals.about: Toggle labelled Mineral Abundance that drops planets with poor or ultra poor minerals from the list.

restrict_range.title: Planets In Range Filter
restrict_range.about: Toggle labelled Planets In Range that keeps only planets within ship range of a colony.

send_colony.title: Send Colony Ship
send_colony.about: Button that sends a colony ship to the picked planet.

send_outpost.title: Send Outpost Ship
send_outpost.about: Button that sends an outpost ship to the picked planet.

return.title: Return Button
return.about: Slanted button at the foot of the side panel that closes the screen.

help_popup.title: Help Panel
help_popup.about: Shown only while right-click help is open; holds the help text for the clicked control.
